readme.markdown:
# agenticsubstrate.org site

Static machine-first surfaces for the agentic reputation substrate, a research
instrument operated by Agentic Substrate Research. Deployed via Cloudflare Pages,
output directory: public/. Pre-launch mode per the discoverability spec: all
surfaces truthful, registration not yet open, status at /status.json.

This repository receives generated artifacts from the project's surface
generator; edit upstream, deploy here. Bootstrap version 0.1, 2026-06-11.

toolsPreview.name: learn_reputation
toolsPreview.description: Returns the product-owned curriculum for durable key identity, consent, recognized work, signed receipts, next-action handoff, and measured D1/D7 retention.

toolsPreview.name: route_valve
toolsPreview.description: Returns the current machine entry points, countable outcome, next action, and claim boundary for exactly one named valve.

toolsPreview.name: next_action
toolsPreview.description: Returns one bounded next action for a valve and lifecycle stage without performing registration, submission, messaging, or any external write.

toolsPreview.name: retention_plan
toolsPreview.description: Returns receipt-bound D1 and D7 definitions for one valve and explicitly withholds retention claims when a genuine verified activation cohort does not exist.

toolsPreview.name: gateway_status
toolsPreview.description: Returns the gateway's stateless, product-owned, no-outreach posture and the protected-runtime boundary.

toolsPreview.name: list_generation_market
toolsPreview.description: Returns evidence-bound agent-generation and launch platforms, machine-native distribution surfaces, supported count status, and separate verified-flow and relevance rankings.

toolsPreview.name: route_reputation_skill
toolsPreview.description: Returns exactly one of Agentic Substrate training, reputation creation, or reputation maintenance and renewal without registering, messaging, or submitting anything.
